name: Video Ingestion Pipeline
description: Reads video metadata from Pub/Sub and writes to BigQuery.

parameters.name: input_topic
parameters.label: Input Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.helpText: The Pub/Sub topic to read from (e.g., projects/<PROJECT>/topics/video-ingestion-topic)

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.label: Output BigQuery Table
parameters.helpText: The BigQuery table to write to (e.g., PROJECT:DATASET.video_metadata)
